title: GPEvac：基于GNN的PPO自适应枪击事件疏散路径规划
summary: GPEvac提出基于图神经网络与PPO的框架，在枪击事件中实时计算自适应疏散路线。采用边优先顺序消息传递与可学习虚拟全局节点，结合置换不变评分机制，使单一策略适配不同建筑布局，CPU上14.73毫秒内完成全局路径计算。
summary_en: GPEvac proposes a GNN-based PPO framework that computes adaptive evacuation routes during shooting events. It introduces edge-first sequential message passing with a learnable virtual global node and a permutation-invariant scoring mechanism, enabling a single policy to generalize across building layouts while computing global routes in 14.73 ms on local CPU hardware.
